text.description_html:
Kwikset 966CN, Single Cylinder Cameron Knob Replacement Interior Trim

This is a Interior Trim Replacement with Cameron Knob. The Cameron Knob Single Cylinder Interior Trim delivers elegant style by evoking a sense of the past. With traditional style, the Kwikset 966CN Cameron Knob with Thumbturns is a great addition to classic homes. Packaged as interior trim only.

Features and Specifications of the Kwikset Cameron Knob Interior Trim Set:

  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Knob Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Knob Projection: 3"
  • Deadbolt to Latch Spacing: 5-1/2" center to center
  • Non-handed knobs.
  • Concealed screws.

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
